title: The Weeping River
text: A river of tears runs through the Pit, clear, salt and very cold, with the sound of a thousand people weeping. To drink from it is to remember every sorrow. Downstream, a bridge of devils' iron spans it.

options.label: Ford the river with your lips shut tight, tasting not a drop.

outcomes.text: You cross wet, grieving for things you never lost.
Water splashes into a mouth, and every sorrow comes at once.

options.label: The bravest drinks to know what the river knows.

outcomes.text: Among all the sorrows is a secret.

options.label: The Leader finds the devils' bridge and dares whoever keeps it.

outcomes.text: Its guards are glad of the company.
